== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (PC Gallery Text)|Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 22 November 2007 at 13:57:23 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
